slides.sub: A calendar habit, not a curse.

slides.body: Retrograde (vakri) is when a planet appears to move backward against the stars as seen from Earth. Mercury does this a few times a year.
Mercury (Budha) rules contracts, messages, logistics and detail. Tradition advises extra care with these during its vakri phase.
If you can, defer first launches and big signatures to a cleaner window. If you cannot, add a second pair of eyes.
Free Mercury Placement Check: see how your chart handles detail and deadlines.
